subject.title: [Bug/Docs]: local+hybrid memory_search quality can appear unstable due to extraPaths path drift + benchmark-file contamination

question: Should OpenClaw add a public memorySearch exclusion and path-hygiene contract now, and should it be builtin-only first or shared across builtin, QMD, diagnostics, and docs?
rationale: The request is not a strict bug fix: it adds compatibility-sensitive config and changes which files can enter indexed memory recall, while an open PR only covers part of the product surface.

options.title: Ship repaired builtin exclusion first
options.body: Repair and land the active builtin excludePaths PR with clear docs and index-identity coverage, then track QMD parity and stronger path-drift diagnostics as follow-up work.

options.title: Require one cross-backend contract
options.body: Pause the active PR until builtin indexing, QMD collections, watcher/sync behavior, docs, and status diagnostics share one path-scope model.

options.title: Docs and diagnostics only for now
options.body: Defer public exclusion config and improve memory status plus docs guidance around broad extraPaths, benchmark files, and reindexing after path changes.

recommendation.title: Ship repaired builtin exclusion first
recommendation.body: Repair and land the active builtin excludePaths PR with clear docs and index-identity coverage, then track QMD parity and stronger path-drift diagnostics as follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the current memory path implementation, QMD extraPaths merge path, and adjacent memory host cleanup.
